text: {"name":"ll_get_channel_config","confidence":"medium","docstring":"Fetches a channel configuration blob and copies its fixed fields and flag-selected optional 16-bit fields into the caller-provided structure, failing if the blob is unavailable or an optional tail exceeds its declared length.","subsystem":"ble","var_renames":{"v4":"config_data","v5":"config_end","v6":"copy_source_base","v8":"presence_flags","v11":"optional_data_cursor","v18":"config_metadata"},"struct_hints":[{"offset":6,"meaning":"Presence flags; bit 3 enables 16-bit fields at offsets 22 and 24, and bit 4 enables fields at offsets 26 and 28."},{"offset":18,"meaning":"Required 16-bit configuration value."},{"offset":20,"meaning":"Required 16-bit configuration value."},{"offset":22,"meaning":"Optional 16-bit configuration value, present when the flag at offset 6 has bit 3 set."},{"offset":24,"meaning":"Optional 16-bit configuration value, present when the flag at offset 6 has bit 3 set."},{"offset":26,"meaning":"Optional 16-bit configuration value, present when the flag at offset 6 has bit 4 set."},{"offset":28,"meaning":"Optional 16-bit configuration value, present when the flag at offset 6 has bit 4 set."}]}
